verdict.rationale: Steel provides its own programmatic, non-GUI automation surfaces that fit headless use. Its CLI runs full browser workflows end-to-end from the terminal, the Sessions API spins up isolated cloud browsers on demand, and a pre-built Docker image is available for self-hosting. However, no evidence explicitly documents running in CI pipelines or a headless execution mode, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD documentation or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), documented non-interactive auth/API-key setup for CI, explicit headless-mode documentation, independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Steel CLI lets you run full browser workflows from the terminal, end-to-end.
the Sessions API lets your agents spin up isolated browser instances on demand
